captions.detailed: A communications blimp featuring a large, grey cigar-shaped envelope hull with a four-fin tail assembly. Suspended beneath the center of the hull is a small, rectangular grey equipment gondola with black windows, which hosts a wheeled landing gear underneath. Two small engine pods with black dual-blade propellers are mounted on the sides of the gondola, capable of continuous rotation.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a communications blimp with a grey cigar-shaped main envelope, a rectangular equipment gondola underneath, side-mounted engine pods with rotating propellers, a four-fin tail assembly, and a wheeled landing gear under the gondola.
captions.factory: Construct the main envelope by lofting or revolving a streamlined profile. Define a rectangular box for the gondola and position it under the envelope centerline. Create the tail assembly using four thin extruded fins arranged orthogonally at the rear. Model the side engine pods with small cylinders and attach dual-blade propeller meshes via continuous rotational joints. Finally, add a small landing gear structure underneath the gondola featuring wheels on a common axle.
